description: This file contains OS abstraction layer functions and PHY register access methods for Realtek network drivers.

methods.name: int32 osal_time_usecs_get(osal_usecs_t * pUsec)
methods.description: Retrieves the current time in microseconds and stores it in the provided pointer.

methods.name: void * osal_alloc(uint32 size)
methods.description: Allocates memory of the specified size using kmalloc with GFP_ATOMIC flag.

methods.name: int32 phy_common_general_reg_mmd_get(uint32 unit,rtk_port_t port,uint32 mmdAddr,uint32 mmdReg,uint32 * pData)
methods.description: Reads a PHY MMD register for a specified unit, port, and MMD address and register.

methods.name: int32 phy_common_general_reg_mmd_set(uint32 unit,rtk_port_t port,uint32 mmdAddr,uint32 mmdReg,uint32 data)
methods.description: Writes a value to a PHY MMD register for a specified unit, port, and MMD address.

ctags.name: phy_common_general_reg_mmd_get
ctags.pattern: /^phy_common_general_reg_mmd_get(uint32 unit, rtk_port_t port, uint32 mmdAddr, uint32 mmdReg, uint/

ctags.name: phy_common_general_reg_mmd_set
ctags.pattern: /^phy_common_general_reg_mmd_set(uint32 unit, rtk_port_t port, uint32 mmdAddr, uint32 mmdReg, uint/
